entities.summary: Song Ikp'il was a Korean politician and Neo-Confucian scholar and educator of the Joseon period. His art names were Kubong and Hyŏnsŭng, and his courtesy name was Unjang. Song was best friends of Yi I, Sŏng Hon and Chŏng Ch'ŏl and taught Kim Jang-saeng.
